description: Entitlement-only policy for the RacePass EventPass mint path. Derived from the source comment and README (see findings/racepass/policy.md). States that a minted pass's linked credential is the one established by the KYC proof. States no expected outcome.

roles.kyc_credential: the credential commitment established by the KYC proof public signals (kyc_pub[1])
roles.linked_credential: the credential a minted pass is recorded against for revocation

notes: The stored/revocation credential == KYC proof commitment has direct README/source-comment support. Recipient==holder and one-pass-per-credential are not asserted here (UNKNOWN per findings/racepass/policy.md), so no recipient or single-use entitlement is stated.
